Calcutta High Court Shocked by PM Modi Poster Depicting Actress

The Calcutta High Court expressed deep shock over a poster depicting Prime Minister Narendra Modi alongside actress Sreelekha Mitra. The court made these remarks while hearing a case related to the poster. The specific nature of the poster, which included a cartoon, was not detailed, but the court's strong reaction was noted. The proceedings also involved a question of whether the actress received any relief in the matter.
